label: Ubiquiti UACC Long-Range Endpoint
description: Long-range PoE endpoint for the LR Switch: two 100M ports, PoE+++ input with passthrough up to PoE++.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: Networking interface **(2) 100M/10M ports**, power method **PoE+++**, max PoE output **passthrough up to PoE++**, max power consumption 2 W, supported voltage 52-57V, surge protection 3kA/6kV. **Both data ports are 100M** - this is an extender for long PoE runs, not a data-path switch, and putting it in front of a gigabit camera halves that camera's link.
